latest.title: KiroHub: Generate a Kiro Skill in 60 Seconds Built With Bedrock Registry and AgentCore Harness
latest.description: I used two Amazon Bedrock AgentCore capabilities, Amazon Bedrock Registry for hybrid search over 10k+ Kiro resources, and AgentCore Harness for testing generated skills against a real agent, to build an AI-powered skill generator for Kiro Hub. Try it at [kirohub.dev/generate](https://kirohub.dev/generate).

latest.title: Get Started with Kiro + MCP in Minutes. Go Deeper with Kiro powers.
latest.description: Kiro, the agentic development environment from AWS, offers three powerful ways to extend your workflow — from one-click MCP server installation to Custom and Curated Kiro powers. This guide walks you through each integration path, helping you start fast and go deeper as your needs grow.

latest.title: MCP IDE Integration Patterns with Okta 3LO Authentication
latest.description: Two production-ready patterns for connecting MCP-compatible IDEs (Claude Code, Kiro, VS Code) to remote MCP servers on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, with Okta OAuth 2.0 3LO authentication (Authorization Code + PKCE). Covers local proxy implementation, Okta setup, and deployment for both container-based (Runtime) and serverless (Gateway) patterns.

latest.title: Enforcing Preventative Controls in a Multi-Account Environment
latest.description: Learn how to enforce governance at scale in AWS Organizations using Service Control Policies (SCPs), Resource Control Policies (RCPs), and Declarative Policies to enhance security and compliance across multiple accounts.

latest.title: How I Cleared the AWS Cloud Practitioner Exam in Under 8 Hours
latest.description: I started from knowing almost nothing about what I needed for the exam, to passing in only 8 hours of study time. Come learn about my certification exam strategy!

latest.title: Turning Karpathy's LLM Wiki idea into Kiro setup
latest.description: Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern — an LLM maintaining its own compounding knowledge base over immutable sources — mapped cleanly onto Kiro. Steering files become the schema, hooks handle ingest and lint, and the whole thing runs as configuration, no code.

latest.title: Building AI Agents with Real-Time ML Predictions: How Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Unifies AI and ML at Scale
latest.description: Discover how to bridge conversational AI and production ML by combining Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with Amazon SageMaker. This post walks through an architecture where an AI agent, secured by a single AgentCore Gateway, dynamically routes requests across four MCP servers — querying RDS, invoking SageMaker endpoints for real-time predictions, and retrieving documents from a Bedrock Knowledge Base, all through natural language

latest.title: From Data to Insights: Integrating Amazon Redshift with Amazon Quick Suite
latest.description: Learn how to build an end-to-end business intelligence solution by connecting Amazon Redshift Serverless to Amazon Quick Suite  from loading sample data to generating AI-powered analyses, enabling natural-language Q&A, and automating reporting workflows.

latest.title: Transforming HR Operations with No-Code Automation Using Amazon Quick Flows
latest.description: Learn how to build a fully automated, no-code HR training compliance workflow using Amazon Quick Flows and Microsoft Outlook  from data integration to scheduled email notifications, all without writing a single line of code.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.
